## Overview

This [[adyen]] page, modified and captured 2026-09-15, is a short **Web integration chooser** for Wallets India. It routes readers to a Drop-in guide and a Components guide, then to the appropriate main Web Sessions or Advanced integration guide. See [[adyen-online-payments]]. It does not itself describe API fields, wallet eligibility, issuer handling, redirect steps, payment outcomes, capture or settlement. See raw lines 15–36.

## Key takeaways

- The Drop-in option points to a child guide described as an all-in-one UI solution for adding Wallets India to a website; the Components option points to the child guide for `WalletINElement`. Those descriptions identify guide choices, not verified behavior or prerequisites of either child integration. See raw lines 19–27.
- The “See also” section lists four main Web guides: Drop-in with Sessions, Components with Sessions, Drop-in with Advanced and Components with Advanced. The page directs the reader to follow whichever applies; it does not select one flow or prove method availability for a merchant. See raw lines 29–36.
- This landing page contains no payment request or response, TEST/LIVE setup, supported wallet/issuer list or success evidence. Resolve an implementation question in the chosen child guide and main flow guide; do not infer those details from the labels here. See raw lines 15–36.
